placedMessage: The provider has been notified and will confirm shortly. You'll get updates here and by notification.
cancelledBanner: This order was cancelled. Anything held for it has been refunded.
deliveryReadyMessage: Check the work below. Accept it to complete the order and release payment, or ask for changes.

cancel.title: Cancel this order?
cancel.message: The provider hasn't started yet, so you can cancel without a dispute. Anything held is refunded.

revision.title: Request changes
revision.message: Tell the provider what to change. They'll send a new delivery.

dispute.title: Report a problem
dispute.message: Our team reviews the order with you and the provider. Payment stays on hold until it's resolved.

review.title: Rate this service
review.message: Your review helps other customers choose.

noDeliveries: Nothing delivered yet. Files and messages from the provider appear here.
actionError: That didn't work. Please try again.
deliveryAccepted: Delivery accepted. The order is complete.
disputeOpened: Dispute opened. We'll be in touch.
payEscrowHint: Your provider accepted the order. Complete payment to fund escrow.
